title: Functor equivalence detected by all core functor-category tests
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent functor categories, cores and functor equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a functor between small quasicategories. Suppose that for every small quasicategory $Q$, postcomposition induces an equivalence of spaces $\operatorname{Fun}(Q,\mathcal A)^\simeq\to\operatorname{Fun}(Q,\mathcal B)^\simeq$. Then $F$ is a functor equivalence. In particular, taking $Q=\mathcal B$ and $Q=\mathcal A$ supplies a coherent quasi-inverse and the two natural equivalences.
